items.title: Illinois Hemp Industry Advocates Sue State Ahead Of Sweeping Hemp-Derived THC Ban
items.description: A hemp trade group is seeking to halt a state law that would take hemp-derived THC products off the shelves of non-dispensary businesses on Nov. 12.

items.title: Fat Peach Bakery Opens 2nd Location In Hyde Park
items.description: With a soft opening this weekend and a grand opening planned for next week, the popular Bridgeport bakery is bringing its scratch-made pastries to 53rd Street.

items.title: 7 Candidates Running In Coveted Race For 25th Ward Alderman
items.description: Aida Flores, Nubia Batista Willman, Ian Watkins, Miguel Chacon, Leonardo Quintero and Chula C. Ortiz are vying to unseat incumbent Pilsen Ald. Byron Sigcho Lopez. Two are facing challenges to their petition signatures.

items.title: 2 Logan Square Residents To Challenge Ald. Anthony Quezada In 35th Ward Race
items.description: Quezada, appointed last year by the mayor, faces businessman Daniel Tobón and affordable housing project manager Omari Bektemba in the 2027 election.

items.title: Family Mourns 21-Year-Old Man Killed In Logan Square Drive-By: ‘Senseless Loss’
items.description: Santino Delgado was making food deliveries with his father when someone pulled up next to their vehicle and shot him Tuesday, police said. Relatives are remembering his infectious smile and sense of humor.

items.title: Humboldt Park Art Show Tells Story Of ‘Rupture,’ Chicago Creator’s New Strategy Card Game
items.description: The show at Coming Soon gallery will have 75 pieces of original artwork made for Bucktown resident Henry Bruce's card game, to be produced next year with community backing.

items.title: 3 Candidates File To Replace Matt O’Shea As  19th Ward Alderman
items.description: Erin Ross, O’Shea’s chief of staff, is among three candidates on the ballot for 19th Ward alderperson as the incumbent retires after four terms in office.

items.title: Sears Sunken Garden’s Historic Pergola Renovation Hits Milestone In Overhaul
items.description: Crews began installing concrete columns for the West Side landmark’s new pergola and are on track to complete the project’s first phase by December.
